title: An automated computational image analysis pipeline for histological grading of cardiac allograft rejection
study_context: Multicenter computational grading of cellular rejection in cardiac allograft biopsies.
population_or_data: 2,472 endomyocardial biopsy slides from three US transplant centers.
task: Reproduce the four-grade cellular rejection standard.
method: Interpretable handcrafted lymphocyte, myocyte, and stroma features with internal and external validation.
main_findings: CACHE-Grader achieved agreement within the range of inter-pathologist variability and similar internal versus external performance.
The study demonstrates a non-end-to-end alternative based on biologically motivated features.
limitations: The model relies on grade of record as diagnostic truth and is not designed for AMR-related features.
does_not_establish: It does not validate prediction of future rejection or broader patient-level outcomes.
relevance_to_project: Useful cardiac-specific comparator and reminder to separate ACR grading from AMR and prognostic endpoints.
